description: Header file defining classes and macros for managing command line flags in the quiche library, including flag registration, setting, resetting, and help string generation.

classes.name: QuicheFlagHelper
classes.description: Abstract base class for setting flags and retrieving help strings.

classes.name: TypedQuicheFlagHelper
classes.description: Templated class for setting flags of various types, derived from QuicheFlagHelper.

classes.name: QuicheFlagRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration, setting, resetting, and help string generation for command line flags.

classes.name: QuicheFlagSetup
classes.description: Helper class instantiated during macro expansion to register a flag.

classes.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsResult
classes.description: Struct holding the result of parsing command line flags, including non-flag arguments and optional exit status.

methods.name: SetFlag
methods.description: Pure virtual method to set a flag value from a string.

methods.name: ResetFlag
methods.description: Pure virtual method to reset a flag to its default value.

methods.name: GetHelp
methods.description: Returns the help string associated with a flag.

methods.name: RegisterFlag
methods.description: Registers a new flag with the registry.

methods.name: SetFlags
methods.description: Sets flags based on command line arguments.

methods.name: ResetFlags
methods.description: Resets all flags to their default values.

methods.name: GetHelp
methods.description: Returns a help string for all registered flags.

methods.name: QuicheFlagSetup
methods.description: Constructor registers a flag; conversion operator allows implicit bool conversion.

methods.name: DEFINE_QUICHE_COMMAND_LINE_FLAG_IMPL
methods.description: Macro to define a command line flag and a no-flag variant.

methods.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsImpl
methods.description: Function to parse command line flags from argc/argv.

methods.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsHelper
methods.description: Helper function to parse flags with usage info.

methods.name: QuichePrintCommandLineFlagHelpImpl
methods.description: Prints help information for command line flags.

methods.name: GetQuicheCommandLineFlag
methods.description: Template function to retrieve the value of a command line flag.
